integrity: The full primary text was inspected through the two-diameter theorem, its Fubini/radial-kernel reduction, and the weighted harmonic Riesz estimate. The new kernel constant is proved analytically by a signed derivative identity and shown optimal by its endpoint ratio. The extension to -1<alpha<0 uses the same source reduction with the improved kernel estimate, whose proof is valid throughout the full integrable weight range.
scientific_limitations: The result sharpens the radial-kernel step and hence the explicit weighted harmonic two-diameter Frazer bound. It does not claim that the resulting full operator constant is globally sharp, does not address p=1, and does not automatically sharpen arbitrary-convex-curve Gabriel constants.
title: Weight-uniform Frazer bounds across the full weighted Bergman range
